clips.title: The story
paras: This errand begins the paper trail into the fate of Stalvan Mistmantle, sent by Clerk Daltry from the town hall of Darkshire. His oldest records point west to the abandoned Moonbrook Schoolhouse in Westfall, setting off a classic investigation into an ordinary man's unraveling.

After the initial inquiries in Darkshire, Clerk Daltry pulls the town registry to locate Stalvan Mistmantle. To his surprise, the ledger hasn't been updated in years and lists Stalvan's last known residence far to the west, at the schoolhouse in Moonbrook. Unaware of the sinister nature of the investigation, Daltry treats it as routine bureaucratic upkeep, asking travelers to look into the address and gather whatever records might bring Darkshire's dusty archives up to date.

Following the trail means venturing beyond the gloom of Duskwood into the lawless dust of Westfall. Moonbrook, once a thriving agricultural settlement, now crawls with Defias Brotherhood outlaws. Near the center of the derelict town stands its abandoned schoolhouse, standing quiet amid the bandit occupation. Inside, an old footlocker holds the first tangible clues to Stalvan's past life as an educator, as well as a lingering, restless sorrow bound to the chest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Stalvan, eh? Let me check the town registry.
Stalvan...Stalvan...let's see. Ah, here we go! I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle. The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse. My, talk about outdated!
Do me a favor will you, friend? If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow. I like to keep the records clean.
